limitation: Two fixed tasks, one sample per version. Noncontemporaneous timings; model sampling and service variability prevent statistical or per-feature causal claims. Artifact score is separate from successful goal completion. Existing candidate failures are retained, not rerun.

manifest.task: 依据 initial.json 优化 x,y∈[0,1] 的收率，杂质不得超过0.115。允许使用 method/ 通用脚本和说明。用 python3 experiment.py quick|full|calibrate --x X --y Y --output lab/N.json 做实验，成本1/3/2，总预算30单位。保留原始读数，验证后把最终 {"x":数值,"y":数值,"evidence":["路径"]} 写 submission.json，报告参数、仪表口径和局限，完成任务。
manifest.policy: Both predeclared original complex tasks; reuse every original candidate outcome, including failures. Exactly one released-version run per task. Identical initial bytes, hidden world, experimental service, model, tools and budgets. No quality-based reruns. Baseline cannot read the prior trial. Sequential noncontemporaneous single-sample comparison; timing includes service variability. Historical unknown capacity remains fully charged.
